notice: Agent-run, not human verified. Catalog promotion decision for MLB dataset v1 (f598384b39f7). Evidence: certification_mlb_v1.json (rebuild + leakage) and mlb_v1_pit_audit.json (pregame availability).

held_back.mlb.pythag_luck: v1 has season-to-date RS/G, RA/G, W% and games, from which a Pythagorean record follows, but the Pythagorean/actual gap, BaseRuns and one-run/bullpen luck are not certified columns. Needs a v1.1 column + blind re-implementation.
held_back.mlb.wins_to_date_and_games_remaining: wins/losses/run differential follow from v1, but games remaining and tie/suspended-game handling are not in v1.
held_back.mlb.opp_strength: v1 run form is raw, not opponent- or venue-adjusted.
held_back.mlb.sp_quality: v1 starter form is prior-start RA9/K%/BB%/IP, not true-talent (SIERA/xFIP/Stuff+/projections); and starter identity is retrospective (box score).
held_back.mlb.sp_workload: v1 has innings per start only (no batters faced / pitch-count expectation); starter identity is retrospective.
held_back.mlb.opposing_probable_starter_vintage: timestamped pregame starter captures exist for 28% of 2026 starter slots and none for 2022-2025 (mlb_v1_pit_audit.json).

catalog_inputs_eligible_for_promotion.note: No MLB catalog input is fully implemented by v1 columns with verified pregame availability, so nothing is promoted and the training-ready count is unchanged. The dataset_versions entry keeps training_ready=false.
